inicio.titulo: Freshly made churros in the heart of Seville

hero.lede: Thin and thick churros, golden outside and soft inside. With thick hot chocolate or with coffee, the way Seville has always had them.

productos.titulo: Two churros, two ways to enjoy them

finos.texto: Thin, crisp and deeply ridged. The classic Spanish churro.

largos.texto: Thick and fluffy inside, also known as porras.

acompanar.texto: For slow dipping: thick hot chocolate or a good milky coffee.

latas.texto: Layered desserts served in a can: cream, biscuit and chocolate right to the rim. Chocolate, or pistachio with cream.

nosotros.titulo: Churros, straight out of the oil
nosotros.texto: A churro is at its best in the first few minutes. That's why at El Don del Churro we make them to order, right in the centre of Seville, and serve them hot.

secciones.titulo: What data we process and why
parrafos: We only process the data you send us through the contact form (name, email address and message), solely to reply to you.
We do not use your data for advertising and we do not make automated decisions about you.
Your consent, given by ticking the box on the form (article 6.1.a of the General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR). You can withdraw it at any time.
For as long as needed to deal with your enquiry and, afterwards, for the periods during which legal liabilities could arise.

Your message is delivered to our inbox through Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc.), an email delivery provider acting as data processor. Resend is based in the United States; the international transfer is covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
We do not share your data with anyone else unless required by law. The website does not store messages in any database.
You can request access to, rectification, erasure, restriction or portability of your data, or object to its processing, by writing to {email}.
If you believe your data has not been handled properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos, www.aepd.es).

secciones.titulo: This website does not use cookies
parrafos: When you browse eldondelchurro.com we do not set any first-party or third-party cookies, and we do not use analytics or advertising tools. Fonts are served from our own domain. That is why we don't show you a cookie banner.

secciones.titulo: Google Maps, only if you ask for it
parrafos: In the “Visit us” section you can load an interactive Google map. It only loads if you press the button. From that moment, Google may receive browsing data (such as your IP address) and set its own cookies, under its privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy).
The “Get directions” link opens Google Maps in a new tab; what happens there is governed by Google's terms.
If we ever add tools that use cookies, we will update this policy and ask for your permission before setting them.
